method.annotationPolicy: right-side printed annotation excluded by fixed glyph-zone boundary
method.reviewPolicy: every extracted skeleton remains REVIEW_REQUIRED until checked against its immutable parent crop

guardrails: Extraction is a raster-derived candidate, not canonical vector geometry.
No phoneme or semantic assignment is inferred from extraction.
Candidate D scoring stays disabled until extraction review passes.
nextStep: Review the 40 extraction candidates against their provenance-bound crops, correct any clipped/contaminated skeleton, then freeze accepted skeleton hashes and enable Candidate D comparison.
